hypothesis: The exact corrected SCDR04 soft-exclusion readout improves six-class causal role Brier versus independent row likelihood Bayes and exact joint partial injection on unfamiliar action permutations, aliases and checkerboard-dependent novel actions, without novelty or alias harm.

cohorts.generator: new synthetic deterministic public 9x9 clipped moves; source owner original worlds untouched; SHA256 domain WSCM-SCDR04-MATCHED-CONTROLS-01
families: one duplicated familiar role replacing one role in a permutation
one action switching between two distinct cardinal/stay effects by checkerboard parity
cohorts.behavior: four independently shuffled balanced five-action blocks; same action/outcome stream and charges for every arm

controls: unchanged independent row likelihood posterior (same candidate priors and likelihood factors, no Sinkhorn)
exact joint posterior of row factors conditioned on injective familiar roles; repeatable novel column, same information

exact independent deterministic version space of five fixed laws plus 20 ordered checkerboard pairs; prior .18 per fixed law, .005 per pair; known synthetic grammar comparison, not blinded source discovery

metrics.primary: mean unnormalized six-class Brier (sum over 6 roles) at steps 5,10,20 across all actions/worlds, report per family and per seed; lower better
metrics.secondary: MAP accuracy, novel probability Brier, maximum familiar column sum, cold restored identical diagnostic on first world per family/seed
metrics.charges: 20 synthetic witnessed actions/world; no intervention efficiency claim because shared behavior
metrics.compute: report exact joint assignment count and fixed Sinkhorn iterations; no wall-time superiority claim

decision.continue_only_if: candidate Brier >=0.02 absolute lower than strongest of row and exact joint controls in each seed pooled, no family mean Brier > strongest same-information control +0.01, novel Brier no worse than row, and report exact grammar upper-bound separately
decision.otherwise: DEV_NO_GO; no tuning these worlds, no promotion

limits.full_final_regression: required before any integration; this is pure detached evaluation
